First true ASM starts at bit offset 73 (0-based).
Standard ASM: 00011010110011111111110000011101 = 0x1ACFFC1D
TX at offset: 00011010110011111111110000011101000101010101000000000000000000000100000000000000000110100101010001000101
RX at offset: 00011010110011111111110000011101000101010101000000000000000000000100000000000000000110100101010001000101
Bits 0..31 in this window are ASM; next 48 are primary header.
TX/RX here are aligned to the channel stream INCLUDING slips.
